title: fix: C_SignInit/VerifyInit/DecryptInit do not validate pMechanism->pParameter for future parameterized mechanisms
description:
src/wp11_pkcs11.c: C_SignInit, C_VerifyInit, and C_DecryptInit check pMechanism != NULL but do not validate pMechanism->pParameter or pMechanism->ulParameterLen. Current mechanisms (CKM_RSA_PKCS, CKM_ECDSA, CKM_ECDSA_SHA256) happen not to need parameters, so this is latent.

Risk: when PSS (CKM_RSA_PKCS_PSS), OAEP (CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP), or SHA-with-RSA mechanisms are added, the code that reads pParameter will dereference it without a NULL check. This is a pattern that causes real-world CVEs in PKCS#11 implementations.

Preemptive fix:
1. Add a parameter-validation helper: validate_mechanism_params(CK_MECHANISM_PTR mech) that checks pParameter==NULL iff ulParameterLen==0 (spec §11.1: if no parameter, pParameter must be NULL and ulParameterLen must be 0)
2. Call it from C_SignInit, C_VerifyInit, C_DecryptInit before storing the mechanism
3. For current mechanisms: if ulParameterLen != 0, return CKR_MECHANISM_PARAM_INVALID
4. When parameterized mechanisms are added, extend the helper to validate the specific parameter struct size and content
5. Add comment: 'Validate pParameter before any mechanism-specific struct cast. NULL with non-zero ulParameterLen or non-NULL with zero ulParameterLen are both invalid per PKCS#11 §11.1.'
